text:
jordan: FYI — VaultCorp flagged a regression in Private where smart routing falls back to the high-latency variant under sustained load. Sales is asking: hotfix tonight (enterprise request) vs schedule in next minor with canary. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/VC-412
rita: Repro steps in the ticket. Short summary: sustained burst of 5000 req/min causes routing policy to pick model-variant-v2 instead of v1-quant in eu-west. Customer sees 2-3x latency spike. Attaching logs:
```
[2026-03-21T01:02:12Z] route_decision: ctx_id=abc123 weight_matrix mismatch
[2026-03-21T01:02:12Z] fallback: selected=model-variant-v2 latency=235ms
[2026-03-21T01:02:13Z] cache_hit=false
```
emi: Is this P1 for VaultCorp? Are other Private customers impacted or just their VPC config? Need to know blast radius before recommending hotfix.
sam: Root cause is a policy-eval bug where the recent percent-based fallback config interacts poorly with empty prefix cache. Quick patch is a one-line change to policy evaluation to prefer cached-compat models. Patch is small.
leo: Ops note — changing routing logic live can cause traffic flips across regions. If we do tonight we need a canary in eu-west then 30m ramp. Also want automated rollback on error rate spike >2%.
maya: VaultCorp is on an enterprise SLA and their legal requires visibility. They asked for a hotfix, but we should offer canary-first and a commit to full rollout if green. We also need a comms plan.
jordan: Customer asked if we can do it within 4 hours. They want timestamped updates. If we can't do full hotfix, they'd accept a targeted canary for their VPC immediately.
devops-bot: Release candidate created: rc/vc-fallback-fix-2026-03-21-01 by sam. CI: ✅, Staging smoke: ✅.
sam: Proposed hotfix plan (90m): 1) apply patch to routing-evaluator (1m); 2) deploy RC to eu-west canary (5 nodes) (10m); 3) 30m observation window + metrics: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, model-variant distribution; 4) ramp to 50% (15m) then 100% with monitoring + rollback hooks. Rollback command:
```
./deploy rollback rc/vc-fallback-fix-2026-03-21-01 --region eu-west
```
ops_oncall: I can run the rollout with sam. Need explicit QA + security signoff before canary. Also need a post-mortem owner if things go sideways.
maya: QA (emi) — please confirm smoke tests cover routing variant distribution. Security (leo) — please quick-review diff by 15:40 UTC. I approve schedule if both sign off.
rita: Comms draft to VaultCorp:
"Hi Alex, we have a candidate patch that addresses fallback routing in private deployments. We plan a canary in your eu-west VPC tonight at 20:30 UTC for 30 minutes, then escalate to full rollout if metrics are green. We'll send checkpoints at start, +30m, +60m. Do you want us to pause after canary?"
jordan: Customer prefers instant fail-open if things degrade and wants pause-after-canary. I'll confirm with them and ping here.
emi: I'll run the smoke coverage and post results in 20m.
leo: Security quick-review done — no secrets touched, low risk. clear to canary once QA ok.
sam: I'll be on call for rollout. If error-rate >2% or latency >1.5x baseline, we rollback immediately.
maya: Great. Jordan, please confirm customer pause preference. Ops, queue the canary slot 20:30 UTC. I'll update roadmap notes to mark this as Enterprise-hotfix decision pending post-canarY.
